triples.tail_surface: Spray shields are to be fitted around flanged joints, flanged bonnets and any other flanged or threaded connections
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在法兰接头、法兰阀盖及其他法兰或螺纹连接处安装防溅罩
triples.evidence_text: Spray shields are to be fitted around flanged joints, flanged bonnets and any other flanged or threaded connections in fuel oil piping systems under pressure exceeding 0.18 N/mm2 (1.84 kgf/cm2, 26 psi) which are located above or near units of high temperature, including boilers, steam pipes, exhaust manifolds, silencers or other equipment required to be insulated by 4-6-4/13.3.2, and to avoid, as far as practicable, oil spray or oil leakage into machinery air intakes or other sources of ignition.

triples.tail_surface: protected with a jacketed piping system capable of containing fuel from a high-pressure line failure
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 采用能够容纳高压管路失效泄漏燃油的套管系统保护
triples.evidence_text: All external high-pressure fuel delivery lines between the high-pressure fuel pumps and fuel injectors are to be protected with a jacketed piping system capable of containing fuel from a high-pressure line failure.

triples.tail_surface: arrangements are to be provided for an alarm to be given of a fuel line failure
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 设置燃油管路失效报警装置
triples.evidence_text: The jacketed piping system is to include means for collection of leakages, and arrangements are to be provided for an alarm to be given of a fuel line failure.

triples.head_surface: failure of the high pressure common rail system
triples.tail_surface: provided with arrangement for leak collection and alarm in case of a failure of the high pressure common rail system
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 设置高压共轨系统失效时的泄漏收集和报警装置
triples.evidence_text: The high pressure common rail system is required to be properly enclosed and provided with arrangement for leak collection and alarm in case of a failure of the high pressure common rail system, see 4-6-5/3.3.7(a).
